title: Senior Cloud Information Security Expert
description:
Join our team as a Senior Cloud Information Security Expert!

Yes, you can! That's our attitude towards our work, ambitions, ideas, and relationships. We at Luminor believe that anyone has the potential to achieve big things and encourage everyone to achieve them, professionally and personally.

Whoever you are and whatever your role is, with Luminor, you will get a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to build a local banking champion.

What You Will Do:



 * Act as a 2nd Line security advisor for cloud and DevOps initiatives, ensuring security best practices are embedded across the lifecycle.
 * Independently challenge and guide Cloud Engineering, DevSecOps, and IT teams on risk mitigation and secure architecture.
 * Review and assess technical solutions, pipelines, and infrastructure from a security and compliance perspective.
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain alignment with regulatory requirements and internal security policies.
 * Monitor, assess, and report on risks related to cloud platforms and CI/CD environments.
 * Contribute to the development and refinement of security standards and frameworks.
   
   
   

What We Expect:



 * Proven experience in Cloud Security, DevSecOps, and DevOps engineering.
 * Hands-on expertise with major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
 * Deep understanding of secure development practices, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform).
 * A solid understanding of information security standards (such as ISO 27001 and NIST) and regulatory frameworks (such as GDPR and EBA) is considered an advantage; however, we place greater emphasis on strong technical skills and software development expertise.
 * Excellent risk management and stakeholder communication skills.
 * Ability to work independently and influence senior technical and business leaders.
 * Fluent English is required in spoken and written communication due to working on the Pan-Baltic level
   
   
   

What We Offer:



 * Flexibility. Flexible working hours, Hybrid work, and the possibility to work from anywhere in the EU, Iceland, Switzerland, and the UK (in total 90 days per year)
 * International teams. Teams that go outside Pan-Baltic borders, where people value challenging work together with good humor and having fun
 * More vacation. Additional weeks of vacation are available to all employees who have been in the company for 1 year or more
 * Volunteer time off. We care about giving back to society, therefore, you will get additional days off for volunteering purposes
 * Paid leave. We are proud of our employees who are participating in military training. Therefore, Luminor offers 30 fully paid calendar days for military training every year
 * Health benefits. A competitive benefits package in addition to your salary that includes health insurance after the first 3 months pass in all three Baltic states, as well as Health days in case of your absence due to sickness without a doctor's note needed
 * Wellbeing. Access to tools and resources that help you feel good and be productive at work and in life
 * Professional growth. Internal and external training programs, workshops, conferences, online training, etc.
 * Special Offer for Luminor products & services. Enjoy special offers & pricing for products and services provided by Luminor
 * Gross salary. 3,830 - 6,110 EUR/month, which is to be determined depending on your level of experience and competencies
   
   
   

We are looking for a candidate primarily already located within the Baltics. Please apply with your CV in English and PDF format!

Luminor is the leading independent bank in the Baltics and the third-largest provider of financial services in our region. We serve the financial needs of individuals, families, and companies. Just like our home markets of Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania we are young, dynamic, and forward looking.

Luminor has a strong and capable team that is committed to achieving our strategic objectives. We are dedicated to supporting sustainable growth in the Baltic region by providing a long-term commitment to businesses and individuals.

title: Kliendioperatsioonide osakonna juhataja
description:
Ühine maailma parima #cyberrangerite tiimiga!

CR14 on juhtiv küberinnovatsiooni ja -kaitse keskus Euroopas. Meie spetsialiteediks on suured küberharjutusväljad ja neil toimuvad küberharjutused, mille kaudu aitame NATO-l ja meie partneritel parandada oma küberkaitse kompetentsi.

Me korraldame maailma suurimaid küberõppusi, oleme NATO DIANA programmi ametlik testimiskeskus ning osaleme mitmetes tipptasemel teadus- ja arendusprojektides.

Oleme hinnatud partner erinevatele valitsusorganisatsioonidele ja ka erasektori ettevõtetele.

Meie inimestele meeldib CR14 eeskätt meie missiooniga töö tõttu - luua turvaline ja vastupidav digitaalne ühiskond pakkudes selle kõrval ka palju võimalusi isiklikuks arenguks.

Tööd ja eraelu aitavad tervist hoidvalt kokku siduda meie hüved: 35+4 päeva puhkust aastas, tervisekindlustus, sporditoetus, paindlikkus töö aja ja koha suhtes.

Kliendioperatsioonide osakonna juhataja

Kas tahad olla osa maailma suurimate küberõppuste korraldamisest ja teha koostööd NATO ning liitlasriikide ekspertidega? Otsime kliendioperatsioonide osakonna juhatajat, kelle töö keskmes on rahvusvaheliste klientide (sh NATO ja sõbralikud riigid) toetamine ning küberharjutusväljade teenuste arendamine. Sinu panus aitab tugevdada üleilmset küberjulgeolekut!

Peamised tööülesanded


 * Kliendioperatsioonide osakonna (tehnilised projektijuhid ja tooteomanikud) juhtimine
 * Küberharjutusväljade teenuste ja kliendiprojektide koordineerimine
 * Kliendiprojektide kvaliteedi tagamine (sh kliendiprojektide monitoorimine) ning kliendisuhete hoidmine ja arendamine
 * Kliendibaasi ning küberharjutusväljadel baseeruva väärtuspakkumuse kujundamine
 * Osalemine rahvusvahelistes koostööformaatides (sh NATO, EL töörühmad) ning CR14 esindamine küberharjutusväljade teemadel
   
   

Ideaalset kandidaati iseloomustab


 * Töökogemus tehnilises IT valdkonnas (nt infoturbe juhtimine, arvutivõrgud, serverite administreerimine, tarkvaraarendus)
 * Tehnilise tiimi juhtimise kogemus
 * Head teadmised majandustegevusest, eelarvestamisest ja küberturvalisusest
 * Üldised teadmised kaasaegsetest IT-infrastruktuuri tehnoloogiatest
 * Eesti keele ning erialase inglise keele oskus väga heal tasemel (C1)
 * Väga hea meeskonnatöö, organiseerimis- ja suhtlemisoskus, oskus juhtida suhtlusprotsessi ja pidada läbirääkimisi
 * Võime hallata mitut üheaegset projekti ja prioritiseerida ülesandeid pingelistes olukordades
 * Olemasolu või valmidus taotleda riigisaladuse luba
   
   

Miks liituda?

Sul on võimalus teha koostööd maailma tipptegijatega, panustada rahvusvahelisse küberjulgeolekusse ning olla osa tiimist, kes korraldab maailma suurimaid küberõppusi!

Lisaks pakub CR14


 * Rohkelt võimalusi professionaalseks arenguks
 * 35 päeva puhkust aastas, lisaks 1 päev puhkust iga kvartal vabalt valitud päeval
 * Stebby spordikompensatsioon
 * Tööandjapoolne tervisekindlustus
 * Haiguslehe hüvitamist alates esimesest päevast
 * Palju erinevaid tiimiüritusi
 * Toetavaid ja lõbusaid kolleege

title: Security Engineer
description:
The company was founded in 2010 with the goal of simplifying B2B content delivery for the modern iGaming landscape. Via a quick one-time integration, they provide access to a roster of 1000+ casino games and a diverse range of proprietary products, including Poker, Bingo and its own rapidly expanding slot portfolio. The high-quality aggregated content is provided through its selected partners.




Now the company is seeking a Security Engineer to join their Information Security team




Tasks:

 * Design, implement, and manage security processes and frameworks to protect ICT systems
 * Actively participate in security operations by conducting risk assessments, reviewing and remediating vulnerability findings, supporting compliance audits, investigating security events, and managing incidents
 * Actively support and develop ISMS: design and implement security policies and procedures across the organization
 * Participate in audits, such as ISO 27001, financial PWC audits and other compliance related requirements, support remediation where applicable
 * Support ISO27001:2022 maintenance within the business by performing related tasks, such as supplier monitoring, ISMS control monitoring, gap assessments and control review
 * Actively participate in Security Operations implementation, improvement and BAU. Tasks include log monitoring, alert development, alert investigation, incident management, incident reporting, security awareness, and continuous improvement

 * Hands-on experience with EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, MDM, DDoS protection and vulnerability management is critical

 * Advanced English communication skills, both written and spoken are critical for success in this role 




Nice-to-have:

 1. Intro call with Toughbyte

title: PAM Lead
description:
Join our team as a PAM Lead!

Yes, you can! That's our attitude towards our work, ambitions, ideas and relationships. We, at Luminor, believe that anyone has the potential to achieve big things and encourage everyone to achieve them – professionally and personally.

Whoever you are, and whatever your role is, with Luminor you will get a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to build a local banking champion.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Privileged Access Management (PAM) Lead to oversee the design, implementation, and governance of privileged access controls across our enterprise. This role is critical in protecting sensitive systems and data by ensuring that privileged accounts are properly managed, monitored, and secured.

What You Will Do:

Strategy & Governance



 * Develop and maintain the PAM strategy, roadmap, and policies aligned with security and compliance requirements.
 * Lead PAM governance initiatives, including periodic access reviews, audits, and reporting.
   
   
   

Implementation & Operations



 * Manage the deployment and configuration of PAM tools (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, etc.).
 * Oversee onboarding of privileged accounts and systems into the PAM solution.
 * Ensure proper vaulting, session monitoring, and credential rotation for privileged accounts.
 * Implementation of PAM practices and/or controls in modern working cloud environments (AWS/Azure).
   
   
   

Risk Management & Compliance



 * Collaborate with internal audit, risk, and compliance teams to ensure PAM controls meet regulatory standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR).
 * Respond to audit findings and implement remediation plans.
   
   
   

Team Leadership & Collaboration



 * Lead a team of PAM engineers and analysts, providing technical guidance and mentorship.
 * Work closely with IT, infrastructure, and application teams to integrate PAM controls across platforms.
   
   
   

Monitoring & Incident Response



 * Monitor privileged access activities and investigate anomalies or potential misuse.
 * Support incident response efforts related to privileged account compromise.
   
   
   

What We Expect:



 * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field.
 * 5+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management, with at least 2 years in PAM leadership.
 * Hands-on experience with PAM tools such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, or similar.
 * Strong understanding of Active Directory, Windows/Linux systems, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), and networking.
 * Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and standards (e.g., GDPR, PCI-DSS, SWIFT, DORA, NIS2).
 * Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
 * Fluent English is required in spoken and written communication
   
   
   

Nice to have:



 * Relevant certifications (e.g., CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust, CISSP, CISM, CISA).
 * Experience with automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python).
 * Knowledge of Zero Trust and least privilege principles.
   
   
   

What We Offer:



 * Flexibility. Flexible working hours, Hybrid work, and the possibility to work from anywhere in the EU, Iceland, Switzerland, and the UK (in total 90 days per year)
 * International teams. Teams that go outside Pan-Baltic borders, where people value challenging work together with good humor and having fun
 * More vacation. Additional weeks of vacation are available to all employees who have been in the company for 1 year or more
 * Volunteer time off. We care about giving back to society, therefore, you will get additional days off for volunteering purposes
 * Paid leave. We are proud of our employees who are participating in military training. Therefore, Luminor offers 30 fully paid calendar days for military training every year
 * Health benefits. A competitive benefits package in addition to your salary that includes health insurance after the first 3 months pass in all three Baltic states, as well as Health days in case of your absence due to sickness without a doctor's note needed
 * Wellbeing. Access to tools and resources that help you feel good and be productive at work and in life
 * Professional growth. Internal and external training programs, workshops, conferences, online training, etc.
 * Special Offer for Luminor products & services. Enjoy special offers & pricing for products and services provided by Luminor
 * Gross salary. 3,830 - 6,720 EUR/month, which is to be determined depending on your level of experience and competencies

title: Security Engineer
description:
Join Relax Gaming’s growing Information Security team and play a key role in protecting one of the fastest-growing companies in iGaming.




At Relax Gaming, security isn’t just about compliance, it’s about enabling innovation while safeguarding our people, products, and players. We’re looking for a skilled Security Engineer who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys solving complex problems, and wants to make a real impact across the business.




What you’ll do

As a Security Engineer at Relax, you’ll be part of a collaborative team that ensures our security objectives are met and that we remain ahead of emerging threats. Your work will span across proactive risk management, hands-on security operations, and supporting audits in regulated environments.




 * Protect & innovate: Design, implement, and manage security frameworks that safeguard Relax ICT systems.
 * Be hands-on: Conduct risk assessments, manage vulnerabilities, monitor logs, investigate incidents, and continuously improve our security posture.
 * Drive compliance: Support ISO 27001:2022, financial audits, and other compliance requirements while ensuring smooth remediation.
 * Enable the business: Create security policies, raise awareness, and act as a trusted advisor to teams across the organization.
 * Stay ahead: Keep up with evolving threats and bring best practices to strengthen our defenses.




What we’re looking for

We’re not just after certifications and checklists, we want someone passionate about security, with the curiosity to keep learning and the communication skills to bring others on the journey.




 * Proven expertise in Security Operations (log monitoring, threat detection, incident response).
 * Hands-on knowledge of EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, MDM, DDoS protection, and vulnerability management.
 * Audit experience, ideally ISO 27001, from preparation to remediation.
 * Relevant certifications (CISSP or equivalent required; ISO 27001 Lead Implementer preferred).
 * Technical edge: scripting/automation skills (Python, Bash, Jira/Confluence automation) are a plus.
 * Strong communicator & educator: able to explain complex security issues in plain English and influence stakeholders who may not have a security background.
 * Degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field.




Why join Relax Gaming?

At Relax, you’ll join a diverse, international team united by curiosity, creativity, and drive. Security here isn’t an afterthought, it’s central to how we grow, operate, and innovate in regulated markets around the world.




 * Impact: Your work will directly shape how Relax Gaming operates securely across multiple jurisdictions.
 * Growth: With rapid expansion, there’s plenty of room for you to develop your skills and take on new responsibilities.
 * Collaboration: Work closely with teams across product, compliance, and operations in a supportive, respectful culture.
 * Flexibility: This role can be based in Malta, Estonia, Serbia, Sweden, or the Isle of Man.




Life at Relax in Belgrade

This role is based in our Belgrade office, located next to Silosi, a growing creative district by the Danube known for its industrial charm and artistic edge. The office is set in a freshly constructed building that combines contemporary design with a welcoming, flexible work environment. For extra convenience, a dedicated minibus runs directly from the main square to the office. You will be joining a team known for its collaborative spirit, supportive culture, and strong sense of community. It’s a place where people work closely together, share ideas freely, and enjoy regular social events that strengthen bonds both in and out of the office.




About Relax Gaming

Relax Gaming Group was founded in 2010 with the goal of creating games for the modern iGaming landscape. Always staying true to the Relax core values - Driven, Adaptable, Supportive, and Respectful - the recent and rapid expansion has been conceived in order to deliver unparalleled global reach. Via a quick one-time integration, Relax Gaming now provides access to a roster of 1500+ casino games and a diverse range of proprietary products, including Poker, Bingo, and its own rapidly expanding slot portfolio.




The high-quality aggregated content is provided through its selected Silver Bullet (commercially represented) and Powered By Relax (commercially independent) partners. Regulated markets are also at the heart of its growth strategy, with both fully supported regulated markets as well as licenses held in multiple jurisdictions.




This role can be located in almost every one of our locations: Malta, Estonia, Serbia, Sweden or the Isle of Man.

Keen to find out more? Learn about us here.

title: Security Engineer
description:
We believe it takes great people to create a great product. That’s why our team lives our company values, and we hire based on them, too. Since 2010, Pipedrive has been on a mission to support sales and marketing teams with easy-to-use, powerful tools that make everyday work faster and easier. Today, our cloud-based software is trusted by over 100,000 companies and used in 179 countries. We have grown from a five-person team to a truly international company of over 850+ people, representing more than 50 nationalities, with ten offices distributed across Europe and the US. In 2020, Pipedrive received a majority investment from Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that invests exclusively in enterprise software, data and technology-enabled businesses, making Pipedrive the fifth unicorn from Estonia.

We are looking for a Security Engineer to have a pivotal role in shaping and executing our cybersecurity strategy, focusing on infrastructure, cloud, AI, and application security. You will collaborate with a team of cybersecurity professionals, develop comprehensive security plans, and serve as an authority on security matters within these domains. If you are someone with deep expertise in cybersecurity and a passion for mitigating emerging threats, we would like to meet you!

Your new adventure:


 * Implement the organization's cybersecurity strategy and roadmap, focusing on infrastructure, cloud, AI, and application security
 * Lead security incident response and forensic investigations related to these areas
 * Evaluate, select, and implement security technologies, tools, and vendors that align with business needs
 * Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2)
 * Conduct security reviews and implement enhancements for infrastructure, cloud, and applications
 * Ensure secure-by-design principles are embedded in developed applications
 * Stay up to date with the latest security standards, authentication protocols, and emerging threats
 * Develop custom security tools or integrate security solutions to enhance protection and efficiency
 * Be a mentor to junior members of the team as well as educate internal teams and external partners on security policies, best practices, and controls
 * Regularly review and update security policies and controls to align with evolving threats.
 * Participate in the on-call rotation for security incident response
 * Enable and support teams in securing AI-driven applications and models by providing expertise in threat mitigation, prompt engineering, penetration testing, and compliance—helping them address risks such as prompt injection, adversarial attacks, data poisoning, and unauthorized model extraction while staying ahead of emerging threats
   
   

Does this sound like you?


 * Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (Master’s preferred)
 * 2+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, with a strong emphasis on infrastructure, cloud, and application security. Experience focusing on AI security in recent years is a valuable plus
 * Expertise in cybersecurity frameworks and best practices within these domains
 * Experience in incident response and digital forensics, with a focus on infrastructure, cloud, and application security
 * Proven experience in developing and executing cybersecurity strategies aligned with business goals
 * Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly convey complex security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
 * Experience in identifying and implementing process automation and efficiency improvements
 * Hands-on experience securing AWS environments
 * Knowledge of EDR and CNAPP solutions and their implementation
 * Experience securing Kubernetes workloads
 * Familiarity with SIEM platforms for threat detection and response
 * Proficiency in Python, Node.js or TypeScript
   
   

Why Pipedrive?


 * People-first culture - Be part of a team that values authenticity, champions collaboration, and supports each other—no egos, just teamwork. Work alongside top talent from around the world in an inclusive space where different perspectives fuel our best ideas. Everyone is welcome
 * Unlock potential – Push boundaries, take ownership, and experiment with the latest technologies as we enhance our AI First Vision. We empower bold ideas that drive real change
 * We’ve got you – Your well-being matters. Enjoy flexible hours, wellness perks and SWAG. Think performance-based bonuses, 28 paid leave days, well-being days, compassionate leave, and even pawternal leave—because we take care of ourselves and our people
 * Grow with us – Whether through mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility, we invest in helping you unlock your potential. Open, honest feedback and clear communication are at our core. We grow together through trust and accountability
 * Packed with purpose – Help 100,000+ small and medium-sized businesses grow and succeed while doing meaningful, customer-driven work
   
   

Based on this role's access to certain data, Pipedrive might conduct a pre-employment background investigation in conjunction with your application for employment with our company. Such data will be handled in accordance with Pipedrive's Privacy Policy for Recruitment.

Pipedrive is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of age, gender, race, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or veteran status.

We are looking for a Security Engineer to play a key role in defining and implementing our cybersecurity strategy.

If this is something for you, send us your resume (in English) or a link to your LinkedIn profile and please add why we should pay extra attention to your application.

title: Security Operations Center Analyst
